scenario: S6R LEAD 216 (3): in-window genuine over-pressure on the A1 flight relight (pad start 1.40 s 300 N, MECO 2.40 s, A1 state at MECO + 0.3 s, RELIGHT 5.00 s at 200 N; flight mode, rule FLIGHT_RELIGHT). From the trigger the head pressure seen by the Pc chain is max(plant, profile x decay): the profile holds until the first ECU ABORT / SAFE or ARM-bus loss, then decays with the plant injector-flow ratio (ASSUMED; sim.h gop). Each case checked against Mechanical's LC-TB70 envelope (lc_tb70_envelope_v1 6f710726e4787134, inside() of lc_tb70_envelope.py 855ebe04dfe5dbd0) on the plant-step (25 us) head pressure: Z0 <= 45, Z1 <= 58.1, Z2 <= 63.1, Z3 <= 75.519 bar abs (tau <= 3 ms, span above 63.1 <= 3.0 ms, 10-90 % rise >= 0.8 ms: input property), nothing above 45 bar later than 300 ms after the first crossing; J-FWD rule = any excursion above 60 bar abs. Pass = aborted and inside (controls: no plateau, informational). SIM on ASSUMED / COMB SIM inputs, not physical approval.
